{{Top|leg}}
An '''aroma-disseminator''' was a specially designed [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component that exuded a pleasant smell. [[Courier droid/Legends|Messenger droids]] in high-class [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] would sometimes be fitted with them.
